import json,re,posixpath
from pathlib import Path
from tests.plugin_integration.package_assembly.test_refresh_guidance import link_findings
sources=json.loads('["README.md", "docs/engineering/README.md", "docs/engineering/instruction-architecture/README.md", "docs/engineering/plugin-integration/README.md", "docs/engineering/release-0-21-0/README.md", "docs/engineering/release-0-21-0/work-orders/WO-RLS-033.md", "docs/notes/developing-se-harness.md", "docs/notes/harness-installation-and-upgrades.md", "docs/notes/plugin-installation-guide.md", "docs/notes/plugin-marketplace-publication.md", "docs/notes/release-delivery-completion.md", "plugins/verity-plane/claude-code/README.md", "plugins/verity-plane/codex/README.md"]')
sources=[p for p in sources if not p.startswith('plugins/verity-plane/')]
sources.append('docs/engineering/release-0-21-0/evidence/WO-RLS-033/README.md')
files={p:Path(p).read_bytes() for p in sources}
for source in sources:
 for target in re.findall(r"\[[^]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",files[source].decode()):
  if re.match(r"(?:https?://|mailto:|#)",target):continue
  p=posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(source),target.split('#')[0]))
  if Path(p).is_file():files[p]=Path(p).read_bytes()
  elif Path(p).is_dir():files[p]=b''
findings=link_findings(files,sources)
print(json.dumps({'sources':sources,'findings':findings,'passed':not findings}))
raise SystemExit(bool(findings))
